Our client likely expects a minimum purchase price that's quite high (at least USD 6,000,000) which should be clearly stated. Moreover, the Agreement lacks crucial standard clauses such as detailed payment terms, warranties, conditions precedent, confidentiality, and dispute resolution sections. To maintain good relations and expedite closure, let's propose a revised Purchase Price clause with a firm figure aligned to at least our client's minimum acceptable price (without stating it explicitly in this draft), and request inclusion of a detailed schedule to flesh out missing sections after preliminary agreement on core terms. We'll add comments indicating these points for opposing counsel's consideration, avoiding any abrupt or aggressive stance to preserve the amicable relationship.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller Six Million United States Dollars (USD 6,000,000) for the Shares, payable as follows: twenty-five percent (25%) upon signing of this Agreement; fifty percent (50%) upon Closing; and the remaining twenty-five percent (25%) within thirty (30) days following Closing, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
edits.name: Revised payment schedule

edits.text: Added detailed Closing Conditions clause for clarity and protection of parties.
edits.name: Explanation of new clause

edits.text: 3. CLOSING CONDITIONS. The obligations of the parties to consummate the Closing are subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the following conditions: (i) all representations and warranties of the Seller shall be true and correct as of the Closing Date; (ii) no material adverse change affecting the Shares or the Seller shall have occurred since the date of this Agreement; and (iii) all approvals, consents, and third-party authorizations required to effect the transaction shall have been obtained.
edits.name: New Closing Conditions clause

edits.text: 4. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES. The Seller represents and warrants that (i) the financial statements delivered to the Buyer are true, complete, and prepared in accordance with applicable accounting principles; (ii) the Seller has good and marketable title to the Shares free and clear of any liens or encumbrances; and (iii) there are no undisclosed liabilities or obligations of the Seller that could materially affect the value of the Shares.
edits.name: Enhanced warranties

edits.text: 5. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Buyer, its affiliates, officers, directors, and agents from and against any loss, damage, liability, cost, or expense arising out of or relating to (i) any breach of the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement; (ii) any undisclosed liabilities or obligations of the Seller; and (iii) any failure by the Seller to perform its covenants under this Agreement.
edits.name: Enhanced indemnity clause
